correctness.rationale: The unrestricted result follows from five explicit steps: A3 and A4 adjacency spectral projectors; rational Haar moments f3 and f4 that exactly yield J3/3 and J4/4; rational independence of sqrt2, alpha, beta ensuring forward dense torus flow; strict full support placing J12/12 in the relative interior of the convex hull, hence in the convex hull of the dense physical orbit; and 3-by-5 coefficient-space dimension with stochastic affine constraint giving Caratheodory support at most 15. The included SymPy verifier independently reconstructs seven spectral projectors and verifies all 144 product entries exactly. Approximate LP sampling is not used to establish the infinite exact existence claim.

value.rationale: This exact twelve-vertex shared-clock observation protocol resolves a natural synchronization test left unresolved by knowing both factor paths mix uniformly under individually tailored observations. Its strictly positive joint-torus moment construction and finite fifteen-time realization identify a concrete mechanism for exact product quantum mixing without independent clocks. The precise graph and exact J12/12 invariant are motivated by the 2023 Cartesian-product caveat; the result does not assert a large unproved generalization.
